comments.body:
Lines 65 to 78 hardcode
- number of hidden layers in the network,
- number of neurons in each hidden layer,
- presence of dropout and dropout rate in hidden layers,
- presence of dropout and dropout rate in the output layer.

Usually, all of these are exposed to end users via parameters.
I haven't seen such enforcement in any other network so far. Is there a specific reason for this? @fkiraly
